name: your-szu-life
description: Install, launch, and connect the Your SZU Life desktop app, then use its local MCP tools for SZU campus life.

displayDescription.zh: 安装并连接泥深桌面端，查询课表、成绩、电费与待办，自动完成登录、校园网和 MCP 配置。
displayDescription.en: Install and connect the Your SZU Life desktop app for timetables, grades, electricity, todos, campus network, and MCP setup.

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我安装并连接泥深，然后看看今天的课表和待办。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Install and connect Your SZU Life, then show today's timetable and todos.

quickPrompts.zh: 帮我安装并连接泥深，然后看看今天的课表和待办。
quickPrompts.en: Install and connect Your SZU Life, then show today's timetable and todos.

quickPrompts.zh: 我这周的作业和考试什么时候截止？
quickPrompts.en: What assignments and exams are due this week?

quickPrompts.zh: 我的宿舍电费还剩多少？
quickPrompts.en: How much dorm electricity balance do I have left?
